level1.prompt: Riley with a crush or a partner is…

options.label: We
options.t: Clingy mode: wants to see them daily and share every detail.

options.label: Me
options.t: Solo mode: loves hard, still guards solo nights and bestie nights.

level1.prompt: You show Riley the angry text you're about to send. Bad idea. Riley…

options.label: Soft
options.t: "I get why you're mad." Holds you first, talks you down later.

level1.prompt: Picture Riley's future home on a big holiday. It's…

options.label: Classic
options.t: The classic: rituals, the family table, parents at ease.

options.label: Own
options.t: A remix: their own rituals, their own rules, no template.

level1.prompt: Riley gets a surprise bonus. By Friday…

options.label: Venture
options.t: A flight is booked. Life is short.

level1.prompt: Talking plans and life progress, Riley is…

options.label: Push
options.t: Ambitious: wants real wins and a direction, soon.

options.label: Easy
options.t: Unbothered: who gets promoted or married when is not their business.

level1.prompt: Lines, house rules, what's fair: Riley is…

options.label: Rules
options.t: Rulebook: the same rules for everyone is the only fair way.

options.label: Context
options.t: Case by case: rules are fixed, people aren't.

cards.prompt: Riley and an old close friend haven't texted in four months. How does Riley feel?
cards.ownerSaid: Kind of stings. Someone should've texted. Them.

cards.prompt: Riley finds $200 in an old jacket. Where does it go?
Riley's person tells the same party story every time, and it stopped landing months ago. Riley...
cards.a: Says it on the ride home: 'Retire the bear.'
cards.b: Laughs like it's the first time, every time.
cards.ownerSaid: Jumped in and told it with them, only faster.

cards.prompt: A friend whose parents helped a lot says 'I worked so hard for this.' What does Riley think?
cards.ownerSaid: Must be nice. Somebody had to say it.

cards.prompt: On a normal week with a partner or closest friend, Riley would rather...
cards.a: Share every free evening and narrate the whole day.
cards.b: Keep some nights solo, no explaining needed.
cards.ownerSaid: If they're free, I'm suddenly free too. + They get a play-by-play of my day. Photos of lunch included.

cards.prompt: Riley's sibling keeps needing a rescue, and the parents say 'help, you're family.' Riley is the…
cards.b: Deadline. 'Last time' comes with an actual date.
cards.ownerSaid: Ghost. Suddenly busy whenever they call.

cards.prompt: Last time a friend's plan cost way more than Riley wanted to spend, they...
cards.a: Went, paid, and lived on noodles after.
cards.b: Admitted it was over budget, after three drafts.
cards.ownerSaid: Invented a clash. Sent a very long, very sweet message instead.

cards.prompt: Months of small clashes with someone close, nobody at fault. Riley would...
cards.a: Make a deal and give it time.
cards.b: Call it. Not a fit is reason enough.
cards.ownerSaid: Let it fade. No fight, just fewer plans.

cards.prompt: Riley's family says 'absolutely not' to a plan. What does Riley do?
cards.a: Sends a sibling or an aunt in first to soften them up.
cards.b: Says 'I'll think about it,' waits till they forget, does it.
cards.ownerSaid: Said I'd 'think about it.' Waited till they forgot, then did it.

cards.prompt: Game night. A friend wins Uno with a stack that isn't in the official rules. Riley...
cards.a: Pulls up the official rules and reads them out
cards.b: Lets it slide. They haven't won all night
cards.ownerSaid: Draw six. Stacking is the best part of Uno.

cards.prompt: Someone Riley's age posts huge news: dream job, dream school. What would they do?
cards.a: Double-tap and forget it by the next video.
cards.ownerSaid: Double-tapped. Forgot it by the next video.

cards.prompt: Someone Riley has talked to every day for three months asks, 'So... what are we?' Riley would...
cards.a: Make it official. Bio updated, family dinner booked.
cards.b: 'Do we need a label? I like what this is.'
cards.ownerSaid: 'Do we need a label? I like what this is.'

level3.prompt: Which of these 12 are the real Riley? Pick 5.

cards.name: Needs a save point
cards.heart: Wanting solid ground is how I take care of myself.

cards.name: Books it, figures it out later
cards.heart: My best stories start with 'okay, this is a bad idea, but'.

cards.name: Actually read the rulebook
cards.heart: Fair isn't cold to me. It's safe.

cards.name: Tells the AI first
cards.heart: Feeling understood counts, wherever it comes from.

cards.name: Bends rules for good reasons
cards.heart: I look at the person, not the form.

cards.name: Keeps the receipts
cards.heart: I look after the person who got hurt first.

cards.name: Typos and all, my own words
cards.heart: My messy real words are the truest version of me.

cards.name: Dating, not merging
cards.heart: I'm me first. Then I'm someone's someone.

cards.name: Rainy-day fund devotee
cards.heart: Being ready is how I relax.

cards.name: Head over heels, eyes open
cards.heart: I love all the way, and I know where the door is.

cards.name: Still loading, and that's fine
cards.heart: My timeline is mine to write.

cards.name: Mayor of every group chat
cards.heart: Nobody stays a stranger for long around me.

stingPick.prompt: Which of these 4 lines would leave Riley speechless for three seconds?

lines.t: You say it's just for you. You still notice exactly who noticed.
You're everyone's plan B. Your own plan A keeps moving to next month.
You think people made the rules, so the rules should bend for people.
To you, fair isn't paying the same. It's straining the same.

pickTheRoast.prompt: Pick the roast Riley would laugh at hardest.

lines.t: Sent me a payment request for $3.47. For fries. With a fries emoji.
Forgave everyone years ago. The screenshots folder did not.
Has ordered the exact same thing at our spot since the day we met.
Booked the flight first. Checked the bank app second. Maybe.
Says 'we're keeping it casual.' Already knows their coffee order by heart.
Made a spreadsheet for the group trip. It has tabs. Plural.
